Package io.github.jabrena.juno.maven

package io.github.jabrena.juno.maven
The Maven integration for Juno: goals that generate a sketch, verify and flash it with Arduino CLI, and open its serial monitor.
  • CompileMojo (juno:compile) — generates the .S assembly, C++ runtime shim, and .ino wrapper for a configured entry point.
  • VerifyMojo (juno:verify) — compiles, then builds the sketch with arduino-cli compile, no board required.
  • UploadMojo (juno:upload) — compiles, verifies, resolves the board's serial port, and flashes it.
  • MonitorMojo (juno:monitor) — resolves the board's serial port and opens an interactive arduino-cli monitor session.
  • EnvMojo (juno:env) — exports a git-ignored .env file into the Maven JVM's real process environment before compile runs, so a program's System.getenv(...) reads (Wi-Fi credentials, hosts, paths) resolve without exporting shell variables by hand.

AbstractJunoMojo and AbstractArduinoMojo hold the shared configuration (entry point, classpath, output directory, FQBN/port overrides) and behavior (invoking JunoCompiler, resolving a board's port) the compile/verify/upload goals build on. The package-private ArduinoCli, CommandExecutor, and SystemCommandExecutor types wrap arduino-cli invocations behind a small, testable seam, with ArduinoCliException as their failure type.
